title: I Put the Missing-Umbrella Photo on the Coat-Check They Ran

parts.text: I handed over a yellow umbrella with ticket 44. At 11:08 p.m. coat-check said they had never seen yellow. The camera above their own sign said: ALL ITEMS LOGGED. I was twenty-nine, soaked, holding 44. I photographed the empty hook, the sign, and the still of my yellow going in. I taped the still to the coat-check window they ran. A supervisor pulled yellow from the staff closet. They apologized in a whisper. I walked into rain that finally had a roof. Ticket 44 still lives on my keychain as a joke that is not.

social.video_title: Coat-check had never seen yellow — Part 1/1
social.description: Ticket 44, a staff closet, and a camera over their sign. I taped the still to the window. Would you have walked home wet?
